title: Impulse Space partner strip
description: A black strip with a small uppercase mono label. Desktop: one row of partner names drifting slowly left in an endless marquee, faded at both edges. Phones: a 2×4 grid where each slot quietly swaps between two names with a soft blur and fade, staggered across the grid.
notes: partners are plain-text names (give logos as ReactNode if you have them); sixteen fill both layouts
a .dark scope: always black with white text
CSS only; with reduced motion the marquee stands still and each phone slot keeps its first name
